title: Listen and Choose a Response — On the Bus

questions.stem: Isn't this your stop coming up?

options.A: Oh, thanks! I almost missed it.
options.B: The bus stops running at midnight.
options.C: I'll stop by your place later.
options.D: Yes, I got off two stops ago.

questions.explanation: Thanking the speaker for the reminder is natural; the distractors repeat 'stop' with other meanings or contradict.
